ck_container_assignments_loaded.name: ck_container_assignments_loaded
ck_container_assignments_loaded.value: "container_motorcycle_assignments"."state" NOT IN ('LOADED', 'UNLOADED') OR "container_motorcycle_assignments"."loaded_at" IS NOT NULL

ck_container_assignments_unload_order.name: ck_container_assignments_unload_order
ck_container_assignments_unload_order.value: "container_motorcycle_assignments"."unloaded_at" IS NULL OR ("container_motorcycle_assignments"."loaded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "container_motorcycle_assignments"."unloaded_at" >= "container_motorcycle_assignments"."loaded_at")

ck_gallery_categories_slug.name: ck_gallery_categories_slug
ck_gallery_categories_slug.value: length("gallery_categories"."slug") BETWEEN 2 AND 80 AND "gallery_categories"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

ck_gallery_items_customer_scope.name: ck_gallery_items_customer_scope
ck_gallery_items_customer_scope.value: "gallery_items"."visibility" <> 'CUSTOMER_JOB' OR ("gallery_items"."company_id" IS NOT NULL AND "gallery_items"."job_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_gallery_items_public_scope.name: ck_gallery_items_public_scope
ck_gallery_items_public_scope.value: "gallery_items"."visibility" <> 'PUBLIC' OR ("gallery_items"."company_id" IS NULL AND "gallery_items"."job_id" IS NULL)

ck_gallery_items_published_actor.name: ck_gallery_items_published_actor
ck_gallery_items_published_actor.value: "gallery_items"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' OR ("gallery_items"."published_by" IS NOT NULL AND "gallery_items"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_motorcycle_import_rows_import_marker.name: ck_motorcycle_import_rows_import_marker
ck_motorcycle_import_rows_import_marker.value: ("motorcycle_import_rows"."validation_status" = 'IMPORTED' AND "motorcycle_import_rows"."imported_record_id" IS NOT NULL AND "motorcycle_import_rows"."imported_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("motorcycle_import_rows"."validation_status" <> 'IMPORTED' AND "motorcycle_import_rows"."imported_record_id" IS NULL AND "motorcycle_import_rows"."imported_at" IS NULL)

ck_pod_records_void.name: ck_pod_records_void
ck_pod_records_void.value: ("proof_of_delivery_records"."status" = 'VOIDED') = ("proof_of_delivery_records"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "proof_of_delivery_records"."voided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "proof_of_delivery_records"."voided_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_site_page_publication_revision.name: ck_site_page_publication_revision
ck_site_page_publication_revision.value: ("site_page_publication_events"."action" = 'PUBLISH' AND "site_page_publication_events"."revision_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("site_page_publication_events"."action" = 'HIDE' AND "site_page_publication_events"."revision_id" IS NULL)

ck_site_pages_slug.name: ck_site_pages_slug
ck_site_pages_slug.value: length("site_pages"."slug") BETWEEN 2 AND 80 AND "site_pages"."slug" NOT GLOB '*[^a-z0-9-]*'

ck_trip_assignments_loaded.name: ck_trip_assignments_loaded
ck_trip_assignments_loaded.value: "trip_motorcycle_assignments"."state" NOT IN ('LOADED', 'UNLOADED') OR "trip_motorcycle_assignments"."loaded_at" IS NOT NULL

ck_trip_assignments_unload_order.name: ck_trip_assignments_unload_order
ck_trip_assignments_unload_order.value: "trip_motorcycle_assignments"."unloaded_at" IS NULL OR ("trip_motorcycle_assignments"."loaded_at" IS NOT NULL AND "trip_motorcycle_assignments"."unloaded_at" >= "trip_motorcycle_assignments"."loaded_at")

ck_trips_route.name: ck_trips_route
ck_trips_route.value: length("trips"."origin") BETWEEN 1 AND 200 AND length("trips"."destination") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

ck_trips_planned_order.name: ck_trips_planned_order
ck_trips_planned_order.value: "trips"."planned_arrival_at" IS NULL OR "trips"."planned_departure_at" IS NULL OR "trips"."planned_arrival_at" >= "trips"."planned_departure_at"

ck_trips_actual_order.name: ck_trips_actual_order
ck_trips_actual_order.value: "trips"."actual_arrival_at" IS NULL OR "trips"."actual_departure_at" IS NULL OR "trips"."actual_arrival_at" >= "trips"."actual_departure_at"

ck_trucks_code.name: ck_trucks_code
ck_trucks_code.value: length("trucks"."code") BETWEEN 2 AND 30 AND "trucks"."code" NOT GLOB '*[^A-Z0-9-]*'

ck_trucks_registration.name: ck_trucks_registration
ck_trucks_registration.value: "trucks"."registration" IS NULL OR length("trucks"."registration") BETWEEN 2 AND 30
